name: Ganath
description: Ganath was a planet located in Hutt Space and the Slice's Ganath system. It was situated in grid square R-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At Ganath, members of the sentient Hutt species engaged in illicit activities. It shared its name with the Ganath Cloud nebula.
